baseline_models.focus_anchor: زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence is not concealment followed by ignorance, but cosmetic revaluation followed by directional exclusion while discernment remains present. Insight fails to govern conduct because deliberate acts have been made desirable.

activation_trace.role: An imposed display of attractiveness supplies the value-recoding step that makes a harmful course desirable.
The defiant instigator supplies an agent for the recoding without erasing the actors' ownership of their conduct.
Intentional doing keeps the decorated objects as accountable choices rather than involuntary impressions.
Turning or preventing supplies the causal transition from attraction to lost access.
A traversable means toward an end gives the loss a directional rather than merely informational structure.
Existence in time makes discernment a concurrent condition, not merely a capacity possessed before diversion.
Penetrating inward discernment supplies the preserved cognitive capacity whose practical authority has failed.

changed_reading.before: They were diverted because they could not see the truth.
changed_reading.after: They retained discernment, but the desirability assigned to their own acts displaced discernment as the faculty governing direction.

baseline_models.mechanism: Clarity issues from places of habitation themselves. The dwellings function as a material counter-display: what their deeds once looked like to them is answered by what their settled places now disclose to the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into clarity makes the habitations evidentiary rather than decorative scenery.
An inhabited abode supplies the built carrier from which the people's trajectory can be read.
A stable locus of settlement supplies persistence to the evidence after the human course has ended.
Displayed attractiveness supplies the rival surface whose credibility the habitations overturn.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings merely locate two peoples from the past.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings are a counter-image: their actions were displayed as beautiful to them, while their own settled places display the consequence to later viewers.

baseline_models.mechanism: A peripheral branch of عمل pictures a road made usable by being worked or trodden. Beside السبيل, this activates a path-forming account of habit: repeated, beautified deeds wear a rival course until the intended route becomes difficult to enter.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful acts supply the repeated behavioral units from which a course can accumulate.
The image of a worked, well-traveled road supplies the exploratory link by which deeds become path-making habits.
Making the acts attractive supplies the reward that encourages their repetition.
Diversion supplies the resulting exclusion from the competing route.
The explicit road or means anchors the worn-track analogy in the focus construction.

changed_reading.before: Satan blocks a road that remains independent of the people's deeds.
changed_reading.after: Their beautified deeds themselves accumulate into a rival, well-worn course that behaviorally blocks the intended path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening assay of professed belief sharpens the focus into a test of translation: the issue is not whether information reaches the person, but whether inward assent and discernment become truthful action when another course is made attractive.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the claimed inner state placed under examination.
Assaying a person as one assays material supplies a test that reveals operative quality.
Making a claim true through realized action supplies the criterion by which the assay distinguishes fidelity.
Attractive recoding supplies the pressure under which knowledge and conduct separate.
Deliberate conduct supplies the tested output rather than mere verbal profession.
Inward discernment supplies the knowledge whose practical translation is being assayed.

structural_cues: 29:2 asks whether a spoken claim of belief will be left untested.
29:3 repeats the testing language and distinguishes those who make their claim true from those who falsify it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assent, assay, enacted truth, and the focus's sight-action split; I supply the arrow that the assay tests whether knowledge governs conduct. A live alternative is that the trial merely exposes an already settled allegiance.

changed_reading.before: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is an isolated irony about knowledgeable wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: It marks the precise failure the surah's trial exposes: cognitive sight survives while fidelity at the level of action fails its assay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Diversion becomes socially distributed. Recruitment onto a human-authored way, a false promise to bear liability, affection around common objects, collective assembly, and literal road interception form an infrastructure through which Satanic beautification can operate.

activation_trace.role: Defiant instigation anchors the distributed social operations to the focus's named agency.
Prevention and redirection supply the shared result of the several social operations.
Moving behind a leader supplies active recruitment onto another group's itinerary.
A route used to reach an end makes 'our way' a concrete competitor to the focus path.
Bearing culpable weight supplies the false risk-transfer promise that lowers the recruit's perceived cost.
Mutual affection supplies the social reward that stabilizes the shared false course.
Forcibly intercepting a road turns cognitive diversion into public control of passage.
The gathered council supplies an institution in which the objectionable practice is collectively normalized.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from verbal recruitment in 29:12 to affective cohesion in 29:25 and collective road-cutting in 29:29.
The focus then compresses these modalities into beautified deeds followed by exclusion from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival-route speech, liability promises, affection, assembly, and road interception; I infer that these are possible carriers of the focus's Satanic mechanism rather than unrelated themes. The live alternative is that each belongs only to its separate episode.

changed_reading.before: A devil privately changes each individual's thoughts.
changed_reading.after: The diversion can be a communal routing system in which persuasion, false cost-sharing, affection, institutions, and control of passage make the decorated course socially compelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Movement and directed looking teach the addressee to read the earth; a visible sign is deliberately left; immediately before the focus, inhabitants become fixed to the ground in their home. The focus dwellings thus become an archive of arrested motion from which causal history is reconstructed.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the archive's function in producing intelligibility.
The inhabited abode supplies the material field in which the record is preserved.
Movement across the land supplies the reader's access to dispersed historical traces.
Directed bodily and reflective attention supplies the method for converting traces into understanding.
A residue deliberately left behind supplies persistence after the originating event.
A manifest marker supplies the residue's evidentiary status.
The sign's emergence into clarity explicitly joins material remainder to disclosure.
Bodies adhering to the ground turn the preceding domestic scene into arrested habitation.

structural_cues: 29:20 orders travel and looking; 29:35 identifies a deliberately retained clear sign.
29:37 ends with people fixed in their dār, and 29:38 immediately says clarity comes from the masākin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, directed looking, retained sign, ground-fixed inhabitants, and dwellings; I infer an archaeological arrow from material residue to reconstructed history. A live alternative is that the retained sign is primarily reported or textual rather than architectural.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings merely identify where destroyed peoples once lived.
changed_reading.after: They are an arrested motion-record that a moving, attentive viewer reads as preserved causal evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opposes corrupting settlement with departure, spatial amplitude, and a newly bestowed abode. A place that settles the psyche can stabilize a beautified order, but migration and divine resettlement show that such habitation need not determine one's route.

activation_trace.role: A place or attachment that quiets the psyche supplies the affective force by which habitation can hold a person.
The traversable route anchors departure and resettlement to the focus's directional problem.
Leaving one abode for another supplies the first spatial reversal of settled conformity.
Expansive room opposed to constriction supplies the practical possibility of exit.
Being installed in a prepared lodging supplies a positive counter-settlement.
Elevated chambers supply the architectural form of the alternative abode.

structural_cues: Migration appears before the sequence of destroyed settlements.
Later, the earth is declared wide and faithful workers are promised installation in elevated rooms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, spatial width, and a granted new abode; I infer that this sequence reverses the fixity of an adorned habitat and offers an exit from blocked direction. A live alternative is that the promised rooms are solely eschatological reward, not a spatial answer to 29:38.

changed_reading.before: The habitations only warn after their occupants have been destroyed.
changed_reading.after: They also warn against treating a settled social order as inescapable: fidelity may require leaving an attractive habitat for another mode of dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, clear proofs coexist with pride, clear signs are held inwardly yet knowingly denied, and correct creator-confession is followed by directional reversal. This makes مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ a live description of epistemic possession severed from acknowledgment and movement.

activation_trace.role: Inwardly penetrating discernment anchors the model in the focus's final predicate.
Redirection anchors the difference between possessing evidence and following its implication.
Manifest proofs supply clarity that precedes rather than prevents refusal.
Self-exalting greatness supplies the stance that blocks evidence from governing direction.
The bodily breast supplies an inward location for signs rather than an external informational deficit.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the explicit mechanism of possessed clarity becoming refusal.
Reversal away from a proper orientation supplies the directional pathology corresponding to the focus's diversion.
Intellect as a restraining faculty supplies the missing brake on acknowledged yet misdirected knowledge.

structural_cues: 29:39 places clear proofs immediately before pride.
29:49 places clear signs in breasts beside knowing denial, while 29:61 records a correct answer and immediately asks how they are turned away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proofs, pride, inward signs, knowing denial, and directional reversal; I infer that the focus describes culpable recognition rather than simple ignorance. A live alternative is that مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ denotes worldly acumen or unrealized capacity rather than acknowledged truth.

changed_reading.before: They may merely have been clever people who lacked the relevant truth.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding sequence activates the stronger possibility that clarity was available or inwardly possessed, but pride and denial severed it from directional obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beautification operates by temporal and sensory discounting: deeds look desirable now, remain attributable to their doers, and later return as something experientially tasted within an enclosing consequence.

activation_trace.role: Displayed beauty supplies the deed's immediate favorable sensory valuation.
Purposeful action preserves ownership of what has been cosmetically revalued.
The culpable offense supplies the individualized basis on which each consequence attaches.
The person's own self supplies the locus harmed by the owned course of action.
Physical encirclement supplies the image that the delayed result already surrounds those seeking to evade it.
Experiencing something directly supplies the reversal from attractive appearance to lived consequence.
The repeated reference to deliberate doing identifies the tasted outcome with the actors' own conduct.

structural_cues: 29:40 assigns each seizure to its own offense and says the people wronged themselves.
29:54-55 moves from an already enclosing punishment to the command to taste what they had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present adornment, owned deeds, individualized offense, enclosure, and later tasting; I infer a temporal arrow in which the same conduct changes experiential valence. A live alternative is that punishment externally corresponds to the deeds rather than being their disclosed fruition.

changed_reading.before: Adornment merely makes an evil deed look good at the moment of choice.
changed_reading.after: Adornment suppresses the deed's delayed experiential return: what looks good remains one's own act and later becomes what one must taste.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider-house analogy turns the focus's dwellings into a diagnosis of false security. Affectionate protectors and attractive practices can make a social house feel calming and stable even when its load-bearing structure is exceptionally weak.

activation_trace.role: A place or attachment that gives psychic repose supplies the felt security under diagnosis.
Displayed attractiveness supplies the surface that can conceal structural weakness.
Affectionate support and alliance supply the social function expected from the shelter.
The web-producing creature supplies a constructed but fragile protective system.
An abode or refuge supplies the architectural analogue for reliance.
Loss of strength supplies the hidden structural verdict beneath the shelter's appearance.

structural_cues: The focus's destroyed habitations are followed closely by a comparison involving chosen protectors and a constructed house.
The comparison explicitly opposes sheltering form to weakness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calming habitation, adornment, protectors, a web-house, and weakness; I transfer the analogy's structural diagnosis back onto the focus dwellings. A live alternative is that the spider house diagnoses only non-divine allies, not literal or social habitation in 29:38.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings only become evidence after destruction.
changed_reading.after: They can also expose a security aesthetic: beautified practices made a sheltering order feel reliable although its supporting relations were spider-weak.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus and later prescriptions form rival behavioral routing systems. Beautified deeds inhibit access to the path; prayer inhibits indecency and recognized wrong; sustained striving elicits guidance into multiple paths. Route access is therefore trained through practice, not secured by static sight alone.

activation_trace.role: The image of a road made by use supplies the exploratory link between repeated conduct and route formation.
Blocking and redirection supply the negative behavioral outcome.
The explicit route anchors the comparison among competing practical sequences.
Regularized worship supplies a counter-formative practice rather than another item of abstract knowledge.
Active restraint supplies an inverse blocker that closes access to harmful conduct.
Exertion under difficulty supplies the sustained movement required for an alternative course.
Gentle direction toward truth and road supplies the positive inverse of Satanic diversion.
The final plural routes expand the singular path problem into several divinely opened ways.

structural_cues: The focus marks adornment followed by blocking; 29:45 marks prayer followed by restraint; 29:69 marks striving followed by guidance.
The focus has the singular path, whereas the conclusion promises guidance into plural paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three explicit action-to-direction sequences; I infer that repeated practices alter route salience and accessibility. A live alternative is that prayer and striving are remedies without implying that deeds literally wear or close paths.

changed_reading.before: The path is an external line that adequate insight should automatically reveal.
changed_reading.after: Access to direction is dynamically formed: decorated habits close it, counter-practices restrain rival acts, and strenuous fidelity receives newly opened ways.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea-to-land and danger-to-security reversals activate state-dependent discernment. Crisis strips away settled supports and produces exclusive devotion; rescue and renewed spatial security permit association and false valuation to re-form. The focus's sight can therefore be real yet environmentally unstable.

activation_trace.role: Psychic repose in a familiar place supplies the environmental condition in which habituated valuation can return.
Attractive presentation supplies the evaluative layer temporarily stripped by danger.
Inward discernment anchors the proposed fluctuation in practical clarity.
A vessel moving through water supplies the crisis terrain outside ordinary settled supports.
Exclusive devotion separated from association supplies temporary purification of direction.
Release through separation supplies the transition out of danger.
Dry land supplies the return to stable terrain where the former social pattern resumes.
Restored association supplies the relapse that follows resettlement.
A protected spatial precinct supplies institutionalized security.
Heart-settling safety supplies the comfort that paradoxically coexists with renewed false belief.

structural_cues: 29:65 contrasts purified devotion at sea with renewed association immediately upon rescue to land.
29:67 contrasts a secure sanctuary with surrounding seizure, then asks why falsehood receives belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crisis, purification, rescue, land, renewed association, and protected security; I infer that settled safety permits the decorated habit-system to reconstitute. A live alternative is simple ingratitude after rescue without any terrain-dependent cognitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ describes a fixed quantity of insight that inexplicably has no effect.
changed_reading.after: Discernment may be genuine but state-dependent: danger strips adornment, while return to secure habitation lets the socially decorated route regain control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from عَاد as a proper name to the homonymous return branch. It remains inspectably anchored because the focus inventory explicitly fixes the name while 29:19 uses the same annotated root for renewed action and 29:65 supplies a relapse after rescue. Render only as a root or sound echo warning of recurrence, never as the lexical meaning of the tribal name.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch secures the ordinary reference to the people of ʿĀd and contains the wordplay.
Doing again after a beginning activates a recurrence echo around the named historical precedent.
Association returning after rescue supplies a narrative relapse that makes the recurrence echo functionally meaningful.

changed_reading.before: ʿĀd is only one closed historical referent in a list.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sound-root echo, the name can also warn that the pattern of recognition, rescue, and renewed diversion is repeatable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates an ocular-affliction branch of سبل while the focus surface plainly denotes a path. It remains anchored because that word stands beside مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ and the later spider supplies the same woven material image. Render only as a secondary visual pun or analogy, never as a replacement translation of السَّبِيل.

activation_trace.role: A gauze-like film over the eye supplies a webbed obstruction image layered onto the explicit route.
Actual ocular seeing anchors the imagined obstruction in the focus's explicit vision pole.
The web-making creature supplies the contextual material that activates the ocular-film image.
Structural weakness explains how a fine obstruction can distort access without eliminating vision.

changed_reading.before: They see, yet an agent simply keeps them off an external road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, route-blockage can also be pictured as a spider-fine film over directional seeing: vision remains, but access is webbed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays the conventional moral path with peripheral water-road, falling-rain, and settlement-provision branches. It remains anchored through three focus roots and later river, water, and earth-revival imagery. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological or material analogy, not claim that the focus words lexically mean a water system.

activation_trace.role: A route leading to water supplies the image of diversion as severance from a necessary source.
Rain descending between sky and ground supplies a vertical life-bearing channel for the path analogy.
Provision or pasture that stabilizes residence ties access to sustaining flow with the viability of a dwelling.
A watercourse cutting through earth supplies the successful abode's continuing circulation.
Water itself supplies the material source whose access or loss determines vitality.
Earth returning to life through rain supplies the causal endpoint of the revivifying channel.

changed_reading.before: The path is wholly abstract and the dwellings are inert structures.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological overlay, diversion resembles cutting a settlement off from its revivifying supply channel: an attractive habitat may remain while severed from what gives it life.

strongest_changes: The final discernment clause becomes a knowledge-action split: beauty changes valuation without removing sight.
Satanic diversion expands from private deception into a social routing infrastructure of invitation, affection, risk-transfer, assembly, and passage control.
The dwellings become both a material counter-display and an arrested archive read through movement and attention.
Presently beautified deeds retain personal ownership and later reverse sensory valence as what their doers taste.
Prayer, striving, migration, and new habitation supply competing practical mechanisms that restrain rival acts and reopen routes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses material habitation, cosmetic value, deliberate work, route control, and retained discernment into one causal chain. Context repeatedly reverses each element, while peripheral branches activate path-making deeds, recurrent history, webbed visual access, and a revivifying supply-channel analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ may indicate acknowledged truth, worldly acumen, or merely available capacity; the context keeps more than one shade live.
The clear sign associated with the dwellings may be specifically architectural residue or a broader historical sign.
The social-distribution and terrain-state models infer causal links among episodes rather than explicit identity claims.
The recurrence, web, and hydrological outliers are branch-backed analogies and must not be promoted into lexical translations.
